scripts.android:build: cd android && ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/Android/Sdk ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$HOME/Android/Sdk ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug -PreactNativeDevServerPort=8084 -PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a && adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
scripts.android:connect: adb reverse tcp:8084 tcp:8084 && adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d 'expo-dev-launcher://expo-development-client?url=http%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%3A8084' -p com.libreve.app
